text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHCDOG11, Schnauzer Front Door Knocker

The Schnauzer Door Knocker will say a lot about the people and the dogs that live in the house beyond the front door. This beautifully designed dog knocker shows off the intelligence and high-spirited temperament that the Schnauzer breed is known for. It is finished in a Oiled Bronze that really emphasizes the exquisite detailing of this Schnauzer Front Door Knocker.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Schnauzer Dog Door Knocker:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 2-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
